name: Belgium
sources: Inflation 3.5% (Statistics Belgium consumer price index, 1990). The Banque Nationale held the franc in the D-Mark's narrow ERM band; its central rate stood near 9.5% through 1990.
Tax revenue 42% of GDP (OECD Revenue Statistics, 1990).

Debt 126% of GDP: Belgium and Italy were the two OECD economies above 100% in 1990, the legacy of the deficits of 1979-1984. Public investment near 1.7% of GDP is correspondingly the lowest in Western Europe.
Defence 2.4% of GDP (NATO defence expenditure series, 1990).
Separatism 0.30 is the Flemish-Walloon settlement after the second and third state reforms of 1980 and 1988-89, with the Volksunie at 8% and the Vlaams Blok rising.
